meta.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64 100% definition)
meta.subtitle: Switch 2 remake — midnight-launch one-sitting 100% binge route
meta.scope: Single-playthrough, glitchless, missable-safe linear route to community 100%: 24 Heart Pieces, 100 Gold Skulltulas, 12 songs, all equipment / items / capacity upgrades, 4 bottles, both trade sequences (Biggoron's Sword + Happy Mask), all 6 Great Fairy upgrades, 3 Spiritual Stones, 6 Medallions, and every dungeon.
meta.confidencePolicy: Structure, songs, dungeon order, key items, medallions/stones and trade chains are tagged HIGH. Heart Piece and Gold Skulltula specifics are tagged VERIFY — trust the in-game Gold Skulltula count and a HP guide over any wording here. Once the remake ships, re-check whether the remake adds/moves anything (this baseline is original N64).
meta.remakeNote: Built pre-release on the original N64 100% baseline. Patch in remake-specific changes on launch night.
meta.sources: To harden VERIFY items, do a data pass against a dedicated guide (e.g. Zelda Dungeon / zeldaspeedruns 100% route).

confidenceLegend.high: Cross-confirmed, fixed in the original game.
confidenceLegend.verify: Best-known specifics; confirm in-game (esp. exact Heart Piece spots and per-area Skulltula locations).

phases.title: Kokiri Forest & Inside the Deku Tree
phases.blurb: The opening. Grab the basics, clear the first dungeon, earn the first Spiritual Stone. Don't sprint past the forest collectibles — some Kokiri Forest Skulltulas are easiest now.

steps.title: Get the Kokiri Sword
steps.loc: Kokiri Forest (training-path hole behind the fence)
steps.do: Crawl the maze behind the boulder to the chest.

steps.title: Buy a Deku Shield
steps.do: Cut grass / break pots for rupees first.

steps.title: Inside the Deku Tree — Fairy Slingshot
steps.do: Main dungeon item.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Inside the Deku Tree
steps.do: Skulltula tokens on/behind webs and vines.

steps.title: Defeat Queen Gohma — Kokiri's Emerald
steps.do: First Spiritual Stone; clears the dungeon.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Kokiri Forest
steps.do: Night-time tokens: on the Know-It-All house, behind Mido's house, etc. (some need night / a few are adult-only — grab child-reachable now).

phases.title: Lost Woods, Saria's Song & Forest detours
phases.blurb: Pick up Saria's Song, the Lost Woods minigames, and forest Heart Pieces / upgrades on your way out.

steps.title: Learn Saria's Song
steps.do: Navigate the Lost Woods correct-exit sequence to the Meadow.

steps.title: Skull Kid Heart Piece
steps.do: Play Saria's Song / Zelda's Lullaby for the Skull Kids for a Heart Piece.

steps.title: Deku Theater rewards (return later with masks)
steps.do: Show the Skull Mask → Deku Stick capacity; later the Mask of Truth → Deku Nut capacity. (Needs the mask trade — flagged so you don't forget to come back.)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Lost Woods & Sacred Forest Meadow

phases.title: Hyrule Field & Lon Lon Ranch
phases.blurb: Cross the field, meet Malon, learn Epona's Song. Field grottos hide Skulltulas and a Heart Piece.

steps.title: Learn Epona's Song
steps.do: Talk to Malon by the corral with the Fairy Ocarina.

steps.title: Lon Lon Ranch Heart Piece
steps.do: Climb the ladder inside the tower to the chest.

steps.title: Hyrule Field grotto Heart Piece
steps.do: Bomb / Song-of-Storms a grotto for a HP and a Skulltula.

phases.title: Castle Town, Hyrule Castle & Zelda
phases.blurb: Zelda's Lullaby, the start of the Happy Mask trade chain, the Treasure Chest Game Heart Piece, and the Din's Fire Great Fairy.

steps.title: Start the Happy Mask trade (Weird Egg)
steps.do: Get the Weird Egg → hatches into a Cucco → wakes Talon. Trade chain begins.

steps.title: Learn Zelda's Lullaby
steps.loc: Hyrule Castle courtyard (Impa, after meeting Zelda)
steps.do: Sneak past guards to the courtyard.

steps.title: Deliver Zelda's Letter → Keaton Mask
steps.do: Letter to Talon, then borrow masks from the Happy Mask Shop and sell them in order (Keaton → Spooky → Skull → Bunny Hood → Mask of Truth).

steps.title: Treasure Chest Game Heart Piece
steps.do: Win the Treasure Chest Game for a Heart Piece.

steps.title: Bombchu Bowling Heart Pieces (return when you have bombs/$)
steps.do: Two prizes here over repeated plays: a Heart Piece and a Bomb Bag upgrade.

steps.title: Great Fairy — Din's Fire
steps.loc: Hyrule Castle grotto (bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Magic spell from the Great Fairy.

phases.title: Kakariko Village, Graveyard & Bottom of the Well
phases.blurb: Sun's Song, the Cucco bottle, Dampé's Heart Piece, and the child-only Bottom of the Well dungeon (which holds the Lens of Truth you'll need for the adult arc).

steps.title: Bottle #1 — Cucco Lady
steps.do: Round up the 7 escaped cuccos → empty Bottle.

steps.title: Learn Sun's Song
steps.loc: Graveyard (Royal Family's Tomb, Composer Brothers' grave)
steps.do: Pull the grave with bombs/strength, read the song.

steps.title: Dampé Gravedigging Heart Piece
steps.do: Pay Dampé to dig until he turns up the Heart Piece.

steps.title: Graveyard climb / Shield-grave items
steps.do: Heart Piece atop the ledge; the back grave hides a Hylian Shield-tier chest (free Hylian Shield).

steps.title: Bottom of the Well — Lens of Truth
steps.loc: Kakariko well (drain via Song of Storms in the windmill)
steps.do: Child-only dungeon. Get the Lens of Truth (mandatory for Shadow Temple & many secrets).

steps.title: Learn Song of Storms
steps.do: The windmill man teaches it.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Bottom of the Well
Gold Skulltulas — Kakariko & Graveyard
steps.do: Several here are child-only (e.g. soft-soil grottos). The Skulltula House owner upgrades your wallet as you reach 10/30 tokens.

steps.title: Wallet upgrades (Skulltula House)
steps.do: Adult's Wallet at 10 tokens, Giant's Wallet at 30, plus more rewards at 40/50/100.

phases.title: Death Mountain Trail, Goron City & Crater
phases.blurb: Goron's Bracelet, the first Magic Meter Great Fairy, the Bomb Bag, and Goron City collectibles.

steps.title: Great Fairy — Magic Meter
steps.loc: Death Mountain Trail (top, bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Grants the magic bar.

steps.title: Bomb Bag — Goron rolling game / Dodongo prep
steps.do: Goron Bracelet from Darunia (play Saria's Song); Bomb Bag from the rolling Goron minigame.

steps.title: Death Mountain Heart Pieces
steps.do: HP on the Trail (bombable wall) and HP in Goron City (light all torches / spin the pot).

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Death Mountain & Goron City
Defeat King Dodongo — Goron's Ruby
steps.do: Bomb Bag required; earns the Goron's Ruby.

phases.title: Zora's River, Domain, Fountain & Jabu-Jabu
phases.blurb: Magic Beans, the Silver Scale, the Ruto's-Letter bottle, Farore's Wind, the frog Heart Pieces, then the third dungeon and final Spiritual Stone.

steps.title: Buy all Magic Beans
steps.do: Plant a bean at every soft-soil spot now (they grow into adult platforms for several Heart Pieces). Buying the full set counts toward 100%.

steps.title: Frog minigame Heart Pieces
steps.do: Play songs for the frogs → two Heart Pieces (one for the song set, one for the bug-eating challenge).

steps.title: Zora's River ledge Heart Piece
steps.do: Reach via vines or beans.

steps.title: Silver Scale (diving game)
steps.do: Win King Zora's diving minigame for the Silver Scale (deeper diving).

steps.title: Bottle #2 — Ruto's Letter
steps.loc: Zora's Domain (King Zora gives the bottle w/ letter)
steps.do: After delivering the letter the bottle is yours, empty.

steps.title: Great Fairy — Farore's Wind
steps.loc: Zora's Fountain (bomb the wall, Zelda's Lullaby)
steps.do: Warp/recall spell.

steps.title: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly — Zora's Sapphire
steps.do: Boomerang dungeon; third Spiritual Stone. Get the Boomerang here.

phases.title: Song of Time & the Master Sword
phases.blurb: Last child errands, then pull the Master Sword and jump 7 years forward.

steps.title: Learn the Song of Time / get the Ocarina of Time
steps.do: With all 3 Spiritual Stones + Ocarina of Time, open the Door of Time.

steps.title: FINAL child-only cleanup before pulling the sword
steps.do: Confirm: all child-reachable Gold Skulltulas (some areas have child-only tokens), the Bottom of the Well, child Spiritual Stones, and any soft-soil beans are planted. A few collectibles are far easier as a child — sweep now.
steps.missableNote: Some Skulltulas/secrets are child-only or much harder as an adult. Do a pass before time-travelling.

steps.title: Pull the Master Sword → become adult
steps.do: You can travel between eras freely from here on by replacing the sword.

phases.title: Adult: Sheik, Prelude of Light & Kakariko prep
phases.blurb: The adult era opens up. Grab the warp song home base, then the Hookshot.

steps.title: Light Medallion (Rauru)
steps.loc: Chamber of Sages (automatic on becoming adult)
steps.do: Rauru awards the Light Medallion when you first awaken as an adult.

steps.title: Learn Prelude of Light
steps.do: Warp to the Temple of Time.

steps.title: Get the Hookshot
steps.do: Race Dampé's ghost → Hookshot. (Beat the record on a repeat run for the Graveyard Heart Piece.)

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — adult-only town/field spots
steps.do: Hookshot opens several high tokens unreachable as a child.

phases.title: Sacred Forest Meadow & Forest Temple
phases.blurb: Minuet of Forest, the Fairy Bow, and the first Medallion.

steps.title: Learn Minuet of Forest
steps.do: Warp song to the Meadow.

steps.title: Forest Temple — Fairy Bow
steps.do: Main dungeon item.

phases.title: Death Mountain Crater & Fire Temple
phases.blurb: Bolero of Fire, Goron Tunic, the Megaton Hammer, the second Magic upgrade, and the Fire Medallion.

steps.title: Learn Bolero of Fire
steps.do: Warp song; you'll want the Goron Tunic to survive the heat.

steps.title: Goron Tunic
steps.loc: Goron City (buy) / Link the Goron kid
steps.do: Heat-proof tunic (also free from Darunia's kid).

steps.title: Great Fairy — Double Magic
steps.loc: Death Mountain Crater (bomb the wall, Bolero/access)

steps.title: Death Mountain Crater Heart Piece
steps.loc: DM Crater (Scarecrow's Song / Hover Boots ledge)

phases.title: Ice Cavern, Lake Hylia & Water Temple
phases.blurb: Iron Boots (Ice Cavern), the Zora Tunic bottle-letter is done; Serenade of Water, the Golden Scale, Longshot, and the Water Medallion. Drain the lake when you finish.

steps.title: Ice Cavern — Iron Boots
steps.do: Mini-dungeon; Iron Boots (needed to sink in the Water Temple) and a Heart Piece.

steps.title: Golden Scale (Fishing Pond)
steps.do: Catch a big fish (record) for the Golden Scale; the pond also hides a Heart Piece.

steps.title: Lake Hylia Heart Pieces (child dive + adult)
steps.do: Child: dive under the lab with the Silver Scale. Adult: the lab's diving record (Golden Scale).

steps.title: Water Temple — Longshot
steps.do: Upgrades the Hookshot.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Water Temple & Lake Hylia

phases.title: Kakariko fire, Nocturne of Shadow & Shadow Temple
phases.blurb: Hover Boots, Nocturne of Shadow, the Shadow Medallion. You need the Lens of Truth (grabbed back in the Well) and Hover Boots here.

steps.title: Shadow Temple — Hover Boots
steps.do: Hover Boots are the dungeon item (cross gaps / hover).

phases.title: Gerudo Valley, Fortress, Wasteland & Spirit Temple
phases.blurb: Free the carpenters, get the Gerudo card + horseback archery, Requiem of Spirit, Mirror Shield, Silver Gauntlets (child) and the Spirit Medallion. The Spirit Temple needs both eras.

steps.title: Free the carpenters → Gerudo Membership Card
steps.do: Sneak/fight to free the 4 carpenters; the card opens the Training Ground & Wasteland.

steps.title: Horseback Archery → Quiver + Heart Piece
steps.do: 1000 pts → Heart Piece, 1500 pts → bigger Quiver.

steps.title: Gerudo Valley collectibles
steps.do: Heart Piece behind the waterfall / on the far ledge; a chest of rupees in the carpenter's tent.

steps.title: Learn Requiem of Spirit
steps.do: Cross the Haunted Wasteland (use the Lens of Truth + flags) to the Colossus.

steps.title: Spirit Temple (child half) — Silver Gauntlets
steps.do: Enter as CHILD via Requiem; the child half grants the Silver Gauntlets.

steps.title: Spirit Temple (adult half) — Mirror Shield
steps.do: Return as ADULT; the Mirror Shield is the adult-half item.

steps.title: Desert Colossus Heart Piece
steps.loc: Desert Colossus (plant a bean / Longshot the palm)

steps.title: Gerudo Training Ground
steps.do: Optional vault of chests (Ice Arrows live here); some Gold Skulltulas and a bigger Quiver/rupees.

steps.title: Gold Skulltulas — Gerudo Valley / Wasteland / Colossus / Spirit

phases.title: Biggoron's Sword, the last bottle & spells
phases.blurb: The timed Biggoron trade, the Big Poe bottle, the Magic Bean Heart Pieces (now grown), and the remaining elemental spells.

steps.title: Biggoron's Sword trade chain (TIMED)
steps.loc: Kakariko → Lost Woods → DM → Lake → Zora → back
steps.do: Pocket Egg → Cojiro → Odd Mushroom → Odd Potion → Poacher's Saw → Broken Goron's Sword → Prescription → Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → Claim Check. Several legs are on a clock — don't dawdle (Odd Mushroom & Eyedrops especially).
steps.missableNote: Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → World's Finest is timed; deliver fast or restart that leg.

steps.title: Bottle #3 — Big Poe
steps.loc: Hyrule Field (on Epona, night) → Ghost Shop (Market)
steps.do: Catch a Big Poe and sell it at the Ghost Shop → empty Bottle.

steps.title: Bottle #4 — Lon Lon Super Cucco game
steps.loc: Lon Lon Ranch (wake Talon, play the cucco game)
steps.do: Find the 3 special cuccos in time → Bottle (with Lon Lon Milk).

steps.title: Magic Bean Heart Pieces (grown platforms)
steps.do: Ride the grown bean plants for Heart Pieces (Lake Hylia, DM Trail, Zora's River, Graveyard, etc.). Only works if you planted them as a child.
steps.missableNote: Beans must have been planted as a child to have grown by now.

steps.title: Remaining spells & arrows
steps.do: Confirm Din's Fire / Farore's Wind / Nayru's Love, plus Fire Arrows (Lake Hylia, sunrise on the island), Ice Arrows (Training Ground). Light Arrows come from Zelda before Ganon's Castle.

steps.title: Slingshot Bullet Bag upgrades (child)
steps.loc: Market shooting gallery / Lost Woods scrub
steps.do: Two Bullet Bag upgrades (40 → 50 seeds).

phases.title: Final sweep, Ganon's Castle & the end
phases.blurb: Golden Gauntlets, Double Defense, the Light Arrows, the 50/100 Skulltula rewards, then finish.

steps.title: FINAL 100% audit before the point of no return
steps.do: Compare in-game Gold Skulltula count to 100, Heart Pieces to 24 (÷4 = 6 containers), confirm all 12 songs, both swords, all 3 tunics/boots/shields, all 4 bottles, both trade chains, all 6 Great Fairies, 3 stones + 6 medallions. The tracker meters should all read full.
steps.missableNote: Some content technically still grabbable after, but treat this as the wall.

steps.title: Skulltula House 50 & 100 rewards
steps.do: Heart Piece at 50 tokens (already listed) and the Huge Rupee at 100.

steps.title: Ganon's Castle — Golden Gauntlets & Double Defense
steps.do: Light Arrows from Zelda; the Spirit trial / castle grants Golden Gauntlets; the moat Great Fairy gives Double Defense.

steps.title: Defeat Ganondorf / Ganon — finish the game
steps.do: 100% in one sitting. GG.
